title: Aligning Policy Encoders with a Shape Teacher
abstract: arXiv:2611.08275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D-aware representations can improve robotic manipulation by providing geometric information that is robust to changes in viewpoint, object position, and occlusion. However, using 3D inputs at deployment requires additional sensing and processing, making image-based policies more practical. We ask whether an image-based policy can acquire 3D shape information during training while retaining a purely image-based interface at deployment. We propose shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism that uses a pretrained 3D shape representation as an alignment target for an image-based policy encoder. Specifically, we use Point-MAE features from individual objects as targets for corresponding image patches, transferring geometric structure to the policy without changing its deployment inputs or architecture. translated_title: 将策略编码器与形状教师对齐
translated_abstract: 具备3D感知的表示可以通过提供对视角变化、物体位置和遮挡具有鲁棒性的几何信息来改善机器人操作。然而，在部署时使用3D输入需要额外的传感设备和处理，这使得基于图像的策略更为实用。我们提出一个问题：基于图像的策略能否在训练期间获取3D形状信息，同时在部署时保持纯图像接口？我们提出形状教师对齐，这是一种训练时机制，它使用预训练的3D形状表示作为基于图像的策略编码器的对齐目标。具体而言，我们使用来自单个物体的Point-MAE特征作为对应图像patch的目标，在不改变策略部署输入或网络架构的情况下将几何结构迁移给策略。在LIBERO基准上，形状教师对齐产生的图像表示在物体形状及其对应的部分周围具有更强的结构化特性。
tldr: 提出形状教师对齐方法，在训练时以预训练3D形状表示（Point-MAE特征）作为对齐目标，使基于图像的策略编码器习得3D几何信息，同时保持部署时纯图像输入的接口不变。
en_tdlr: Proposes shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism that uses pretrained 3D shape features (Point-MAE) as alignment targets to endow image-based policy encoders with 3D geometric information while keeping a purely image-based interface at deployment.
